notes: Provenance: supplied hammer-products.csv gzip, exact vendor == Galleria (10,735 rows; all brand fields blank), and supplied shared/seed/items.ts (128 items). Names and units only, not live inventory or product detail pages.

Policy: exact nominal package with equivalent lb/oz conversions accepted; no inferred shrinkflation or +/-15% alternatives. Conventional catalogue items do not receive organic, flavoured, reduced-sodium, reduced-fat, specialty eggs, or prepared-food substitutes. Unspecified pack sizes and ambiguous each/per-weight price bases are withheld rather than invented.

Baseline supplied matcher: 364 best-product matches. Audit: 109 assignments covering 58 catalogue items; 255 baseline product ids excluded. Assignment Galleria067800001026 changes UNICO VEGETABLE OIL 3L from canola-oil-3l to vegetable-oil-3l. Every assignment was tested against supplied matchProduct and passed; all ids are exact CSV strings and all targets are real catalogue ids.

Assignments include verified existing matches, not only corrections, to make the chain review explicit. Exclusions always win. The 255 exclusions mix proven mismatches and conservative withholding where metadata cannot establish equivalence; they are not all claims that the retailer lacks the underlying item.

No raw price CSV was supplied. Cannot verify per-lb/per-kg conversion, each versus promotional bundle totals, current prices, active product availability, historical observation counts, or actual price coverage. The delivered assignments therefore measure catalogue/name-size fit, not sellable inventory or price coverage.

CSV units such as 1LB may mean a fixed 1-lb pack or a per-lb price. Do not force these onto a per-kg item without verifying price basis. Blank units on produce do not prove each/per-kg pricing. Names with 2 for/3 for/4 for cannot verify the observed price is per item. Blank units on large eggs do not prove 12 eggs.

Missing-candidate list below is research for the matcher owner, NOT executable assignments. None of these 23 candidates passes supplied matchProduct, and some still need product or price-basis verification. No overrides can safely bypass that gate.

Untested future matcher changes may surface additional false positives. This denylist covers all 364 supplied baseline best matches; it is not a permanent exhaustive denylist of every non-grocery item among the 10,735 rows.
